# Titan VK56 engine swap

> **Some safety-critical values on this page are not confirmed** (marked [Unverified] or [Partial]): they come from one source or are only partly supported. Verify against the factory service manual before use; later runs re-check them against new sources.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Remove both donor and recipient engine harnesses, disconnecting the Xterra alternator harness excluding the Titan knock sensor harness. [t639]

[Partial] Recover refrigerant from the A/C system, then drain antifreeze and power steering fluid. [t639]

Remove the transmission and transfer case crossmember while supporting it with a floor jack. [t639]

[Partial] Remove the front wheels to lower the vehicle onto short 2-Ton jackstands. [t639]

Remove the front heat shields and catalytic converters to clear path for the transmission. [t639]

[Partial] Remove the oil pan to prevent it from hitting the front differential during extraction. [t639]

Loosen the rear differential bolt and remove two front bolts to free up movement. [t639]

[Partial] Pull the engine and transmission transfer case out as a single assembly. [t639]

Remove the shifter lever and cap off the transmission opening. [t639]

Replace the oil pan gasket o-rings, rear crank seal, and oil pressure regulator. [t639]

Clean out sludge from the bottom of the oil pan and inspect rod bearings. [t639]

[Partial] Install new valve cover gaskets and torque bolts in the correct sequence. [t639]

Replace the water pump, serpentine belt tensioner noting its reversed thread, and idler pulleys. [t639]

Replace intake and throttle body seals along with the thermostat. [t639]

[Partial] Cap off the small coolant outlet below the thermostat that originally fed an overflow bottle. [t639]

Clean the oil cooler o-ring by dunking it in carb cleaner before reinstalling. [t639]

[Partial] Stickers have a diameter of 3 inches. [t463]

Install a Titan VK56 engine into a 2006 Xterra chassis and address harness cable issues where plug shapes differ. [t328]

[Partial] Install a 2014 or newer Nissan Frontier Pro-4X M226 rear differential with fresh bearings and seals if necessary. [t246]

[Partial] Swap the V8 Titan engine and install a matching drivetrain. [t320]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. [Partial] Lower the front of the vehicle to its lowest setting on 6-ton jackstands.
2. [Partial] Raise the hood and use gas springs or a prop rod for extra lift clearance if needed.
3. Disconnect the low-pressure power steering line, noting that flange nuts may require soaking in PB Blaster.
4. [Partial] Remove the driver-side primary catalytic converter nut first to avoid rounding off threads during removal.
5. [Partial] Cut the catback section from the end of the secondary exhaust cats.
6. Unbolt and remove the nuts holding the driver and passenger side primary cats/manifold flanges.
7. Disconnect the shift cable running from the transmission to the transfer case.
8. Remove both front and rear driveshafts connecting the engine/transmission to the axles.
9. Detach all bolts securing the transmission crossmember, leaving just one bolt on each side as a pivot point.
10. Lift the entire powertrain assembly (engine, transmission, and xfer case) out of the truck using an engine hoist.

_Procedure reported by [t286]. Photos of this job are in the source: <https://www.xterranation.org/index.php?threads/how-to-vk-swap-with-auto-trans.8909/>_

## Tips & gotchas

- Use a Fumoto oil drain valve on the pan, but be aware it hangs lower than stock and may snag on power steering lines. [t286]
- Keep the xfer case attached to the transmission during removal for easier handling. [t286]
- Use an angle grinder to cut a half-bolt from the underside if stuck on engine mounts. [t286]
- [Partial] Cut ear tabs off alternator mounting bolts with an angle grinder before shearing bolt heads free. [t286]
- [Partial] Use a Uprev laptop cable to disable VATS and program the Titan ECU using UpRev software. [t639]
- Note that the front sway bar is removed rather than swapped for a Titan unit to save cost. [t146]
- Check for plug shape differences in the black box beside the IPDM. [t328]
- Use a Spicer E-Locker harness kit for rear ABS sensors. [t246]
- [Partial] Ensure the new differential has an extended length to clear components. [t246]
